newsitem.title: FINLAND: MERITA SAYS MET '97 TARGETS IN H1.
newsitem.headline: MERITA SAYS MET '97 TARGETS IN H1.

text.p: Finland's largest banking group Merita Oy said on Wednesday it had met targets for the full year in the first half and expected a good development in the second half.
"We have achieved the target for the full year already in the first half and see a good development in the second half," a Merita spokeswoman said with the bank's January-June earnings.
Merita CEO Vesa Vainio in a statement repeated that Merita aimed to pay dividends "which will increase in line with profit".
Merita had earlier said it expected full-year earnings to be distinctly better than in 1996.
In 1996, Merita posted a 1.20 billion markka profit on ordinary operations.
"I believe it to be in our shareholders' interest that growth in the company's capital base should derive primarily from a strengthening revenue stream," Vainio said in the statement.
